page_title: FutureOS — Agentic Science 科研工作平台

summary.name: FutureOS
summary.one_liner: FutureOS is an agentic science research workspace that connects literature, data, code and compute so an AI agent can carry out research tasks under the user's supervision.
use_cases: Searching literature and database records with traceable sources
Running statistical analysis and building figures from a dataset
Delegating coding and data analysis tasks to an agent
Reviewing an agent's executed steps and file changes
Managing shared research budgets for a lab team
Running analysis on university HPC resources
summary.what_it_does: FutureOS lets researchers hand literature search, data analysis and coding tasks to an AI agent inside one workspace that links papers, datasets, code and compute. The agent handles tool calls and working files while the user guides methods and reviews results. The page says the user can approve important actions, review file changes, and inspect execution records and saved outputs. Long-running work can be resumed with its progress intact. Access is offered through a desktop app and a terminal (TUI), with campus or user-supplied model endpoints as well as platform models. The page also describes planned agents for method selection and experiments, and lists two related products, HERITA (genetics) and GAMMA (target discovery).
notable: Agent actions recorded with approvals, execution records and saved outputs for review
Can connect institution model endpoints or HPC terminal, or use platform models
Team mode with a shared budget and per-member spending limits
Related products HERITA (genetic analysis) and GAMMA (GWAS/multi-omics target discovery)
caveats: Skills are free, but platform models are billed by tokens and paid tools by call or page; user-supplied models follow provider billing
Advanced agents for experiments and hypothesis generation are described as in development or long-term vision, not available today
Sessions and files are stored on the user's device or own server, but remote model and tool calls send content to those providers; check data policies before using sensitive data
